payload.body: Landed 0021_app_boundary migration (SQLite + Postgres): additive app_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '_default' on all 10 tenant-scoped framework tables + compound (app_id, tenant_id, …) indexes. ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN, no PK changes, strictly additive. Gate: typecheck exit 0; server vitest 962 passed / 0 failed / 45 skipped (958 baseline + 4 new app-migration.test.ts). SQLite/PG parity via pg-migrations static checks.
